subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should configured agent descriptions be a supported, bounded field in the `agents_list` discovery contract, rather than metadata retained only in configuration and doctor repairs?
rationale: The implementation is small, but making operator-authored text visible to orchestrating models establishes a durable tool and prompt-surface contract that needs maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor bounded discovery metadata
options.body: Accept descriptions in `agents_list` with trimming, omission of blank values, focused tests, and concise documentation of the intended routing use.

options.title: Keep descriptions configuration-only
options.body: Decline runtime exposure and close the linked PR after documenting that orchestration metadata must remain outside this tool response.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded discovery metadata
recommendation.body: Accept descriptions in `agents_list` with trimming, omission of blank values, focused tests, and concise documentation of the intended routing use.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history and the prior review connect this contributor most directly to the agent roster, tool, and multi-agent runtime boundary.
